name: io.github.CyberPunk11147/cyberwarex-web-access
title: Web reader and Telegram search for agents
description: Read any web page and search public Telegram channels, groups and bots. No API key, pay per call.

environmentVariables.name: AWA_X_PAYMENT
environmentVariables.description: Optional x402 X-PAYMENT header. If unset, the server surfaces the 402 invoice to the agent so its own x402 client can pay and retry.
